findings.claim: Fault8 is consistent with normal supervisor shutdown stop publication after budget completion; do not rewrite original adapter reason.
findings.evidence: mission.py:948-956 enters finally, publishes stop before reference worker close; native stop callback sets8. First recorded adapter fault1794131897.592 follows final supervisor next_action event-file mtime1794131897.543. Subsequent worker shutdown RPC exists. No earlier adapter fault in journal.

findings.claim: Observer and mission are not isolated into separate process sessions/groups by these launchers; child-only cleanup cannot intentionally kill observer.
findings.evidence: run_with_fault_ring.py:44 Popen has no start_new_session/preexec_fn; RUN_NEXT.sh and run_hybrid.sh use exec. mission spawn and ReferenceWorker spawn also inherit group. Mission close_actuator_children sends signals to individual PIDs, not killpg; worker.close terminates only worker PID.

findings.claim: Observer exit143 indicates TERM-style termination; absence of SIGTERM handling prevents its finally/fault-ring/result guarantee. External process-group termination is plausible, but sender/scope/escalation cannot be established from preserved logs.
findings.evidence: Observer disable_signals=True and no custom SIGTERM handler; all descendants inherit group. No killpg in inspected mission/worker/observer path. No root result or stop_feedback_verification event despite worker shutdown. Exit143 alone does not prove executor timeout or identify sender.

findings.claim: Finalization ordering leaves a reporting vulnerability: root result written only after worker close, pre-stop verification, child cleanup, post-stop verification and audit. Abrupt termination during this interval can preserve adapter result while losing supervisor result.
findings.evidence: mission.py:948-1049; observer writes observer_result only after child exits normally through its wait/poll loop.

limits: 40 arrivals/core budget completion and anchor-return ledger do not establish completed supervisor finalization.
Adapter zero feedback is preserved evidence; supervisor post-cleanup zero verification is absent.
